Allow you to define a trust between accounts in order to allow users in a certain account to make changes and operation on another account.
Actions can be taken on a trustee account via a role which is defined on it. 
The role should be assumed by a user from the trusted account.

List of the integration settings which are used to send a report notification
This currently only supports 3 integrations types: Teams, Slack and Email. 
Constraints: You can create and attach all 3 types of integrations, but can attach only one of each type 
Example: 
      ReportIntegrationSetting can have 1 Slack integration, 1 Email integration and 1 Teams integration 
      ReportIntegrationSetting can NOT have 1 Slack integration and 2 Email integrations
